description: A few systems react to what you build.

pages.title: Side Effects to Plan For
pages.text: A few systems react to what you build. None of them are punishing on their own, but a big base notices all of them.

- **Burning pollutes.** Furnaces, burners and stoves add [#](2E5AAC)[smog](entry://survival/pollution)[#]() to their chunk. Smog builds up fast and is punishing. Flues and [#](2E5AAC)[air scrubbers](entry://survival/pollution_control)[#]() fix it.
- **Heat warms you.** Factories near you count toward [#](2E5AAC)[body temperature](entry://survival/temperature)[#]().

- **Height is cold.** [#](2E5AAC)[Cold Sweat: Altitude](entry://survival/temperature_create)[#]() makes the sky chilly, which matters for airships.
- **Water isn't clean.** Drink [#](2E5AAC)[purified water](entry://survival/thirst)[#](), or build a filter.
- **Seasons turn.** Plan farms around them.

**Cold Sweat and Thirst work together.** Thirst Was Reclaimed uses Cold Sweat's temperature readings, so the heat or cold around you feeds into its thirst system. Dress for the weather and carry water.
